subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should the composer token meter hide stale totals like current context surfaces, or display them with an explicit stale/updating state?
rationale: Both policies are plausible, and the linked stale-context indicator work has not settled the visible stale-token convention this meter should share.

options.title: Share Freshness-Aware Model
options.body: Update the meter to reuse or match the existing freshness-aware context model and hide stale totals until fresh data arrives.

options.title: Show Explicit Stale State
options.body: Keep stale totals visible only if the UI marks them as stale/updating and tests cover that behavior.

options.title: Pause Until Stale Work Lands
options.body: Wait for the stale-context indicator PR to settle the contract, then adapt this meter to the chosen behavior.

recommendation.title: Share Freshness-Aware Model
recommendation.body: Update the meter to reuse or match the existing freshness-aware context model and hide stale totals until fresh data arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns both this PR and prior merged context usage UI work, making them the best available owner for the meter's UX policy choice.
